target_customer: US hospitals and health systems that report to clinical quality registries
problem: Nurses and staff manually read patient charts to fill registry fields, which is slow and costly. Pharos automates chart abstraction and real time quality monitoring.
product_category: Clinical AI for hospital quality reporting

founders.name: Felix Brann
founders.background_notes: Published research on sepsis prediction per YC page.

founders.name: Matthew Jones
previous_startups: Market2x, rural trucking marketplace in New Zealand (founding team)

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting registry variables from unstructured charts with evidence links, under HIPAA and with EHR integration, is hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Hospital integrations, SOC 2 and registry vendor status create friction to switch; model access is not unique.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of an incumbent copying or buying Pharos; the company reports deployment at over 100 hospitals on its own site.

market_need_then: Quality reporting is a manual, labor heavy cost for hospitals; the company says it saves millions in labour, and LLMs made chart reading feasible in 2024.

branding.name_origin: Company framing as a lighthouse (Pharos) guiding hospitals, per its YC profile

identity.voice_and_tone: Clinical and mission driven, patient harm prevention

brand_strength.rationale: Evocative name with a clear metaphor, but shared with unrelated companies such as Pharos Capital and Pharos and Thread; no press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Pharos raised a 5 million dollar seed in October 2024 led by Felicis after a Moxxie led pre-seed and reports deployment across over 100 hospitals. Founders with healthcare data experience and a clear manual cost problem helped it win a niche in registry abstraction. No exit or trouble is reported, and the company claims are self reported.
notes: A pre-seed led by Moxxie is mentioned by TechCrunch without amount or date, so not recorded. The competitor search returned no relevant dated results, so the list is empty. Education not found. Alex Clarke is mentioned in a launch post but not listed as a founder on the YC page.
